description: In a countable language, an infinite structure \(M\) has at most \(\lvert M\rvert\) subsets definable with finite parameters from \(M\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Definability.card_definable_subsets_le.{u} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type u} [L.Structure M]
  [Infinite M] [Countable L.Symbols] : Cardinal.mk { s // Set.univ.Definable₁ L s } ≤ Cardinal.mk M
